headline: This 2010 order sets up a council of science and technology experts to advise the President.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this executive order sets up or updates the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology (PCAST). PCAST is a group of outside experts who give the President advice on science and technology issues. No summary was provided, so details such as how many members it has or what topics it covers are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Scientists, engineers, and other experts outside the government
who_it_affects.how: Some may be appointed to serve on the council and give advice to the President.

who_it_affects.group: The President and White House staff
who_it_affects.how: They gain a formal group of outside experts to consult on science and technology policy.

when_it_takes_effect: April 21, 2010 (date signed); the source does not give a separate start date
